SELECT m.request_id, a.name AS asset_name, LISTAGG(p.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.name) AS parts, MAX(m.type) AS type, MAX(m.resolver_name) AS resolver_name, MAX(a.category) AS asset_kind, MAX(m.resolve_description) AS resolve_description, MAX(m.note) AS note, TO_CHAR(MAX(m.resolved_at), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS resolved_at
FROM maintenance m JOIN asset a ON a.asset_id = m.asset_id JOIN part p ON p.part_id = m.part_id WHERE m.request_id = #{requestId} GROUP BY m.request_id, a.name
